answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the gale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the orchard re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
